Backpacker Guild Demo 1.1.4 Update

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924152/96aabc803eaae6b9697105eae0ce1686e5ce95a5.png

- Difficulty Selection Added
You can choose one of three difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, or Hard to start the game!
As the difficulty increases, you need to manage your guild more carefully, and the chance of losing equipment when mercenaries are defeated in battle increases.
If you have been playing the game, the default setting is 'Normal' difficulty.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924152/7b8a5abd2478bcc6a7eb0f9056d0c92c8b20d599.png

- You can send all waiting mercenaries into battle with the previous battle preparation settings intact.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924152/c09df6fc6749f7ac5d73161320e8271db1634de6.png

- A cute (?) protagonist is wandering around the guild.


Other Update Notes

- Repeatedly canceling quests will significantly decrease not only gold but also reputation.
- The reward amount for item crafting quests is calculated by including the cost of crafting materials.
- Fixed the issue where background music played during the opening even when muted.
- Various minor bugs have been fixed.


As Backpacker Guild is currently a demo version, your unique ideas and feedback are very helpful for developing a better game.

Thank you for playing the game and for your interest.
Have a great day!

- Quest Progress Indicators Added

We have added indicators to make it easier to track your quest progress.

Green: If there is a quest that can be completed
Yellow: If there is a quest with less than 7 days remaining
Red: If there is a quest with less than 3 days remaining

As Backpacker Guild is currently a demo version, your unique ideas and feedback are very helpful for developing a better game.

Backpacker Guild Demo 1.0.3 Update

- Major adjustments to crafting material requirements

The endless loop of killing slimes... and killing more slimes... taking a short breather... and then killing even more slimes has finally come to an end! At the same time, the hellish demand for 'junk' has been significantly reduced and adjusted...!

As Backpacker Guild is currently in its demo phase, your creative ideas and feedback are invaluable in helping us develop a better game.

Thank you for playing and for your interest. 
Have a great day!
